verdict.rationale: Warp is itself an agent (Warp Agent, Oz cloud agents), so serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. The MCP evidence (warp-docs-7, 18, 37, 52) is client-side: Warp's agents connect to external MCP servers, which cannot be credited here. The homepage line "API, CLI, SDK and MCP built as a platform" is too vague to count as explicit evidence that Warp runs as an MCP server, such as a documented serve command or a hosted MCP endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
